author_review.reason: Author review for this exact candidate: retained in-memory Pandas option/attention fixtures use complete observed prices with no corporate actions, provider history/cache, live Schwab restart or ProjectX recovery. Event-neutral alignment, full-series dividend caching and caller-frame ownership therefore do not change their messages, prices, positions or orders. Statistics consolidate only after execution. The tool-description clarifications codify the already observed passing exact-contract/order shapes without changing tool implementation or schema; separate owners keep their failed-decision proof. The offline publication-verifier correction preserves distinct immutable inference and receipt-publication commits. Preserve all original native sources, dates, calls, SDK tuples and verdicts; no new model inference is claimed. Focused code checks qualify the affected accounting, history and ownership boundaries. 4.6.54 tool-description clarifications (exact option reads, order-status watch inputs, positive profit-check quantity, commit 69650a2ea) were exercised once each on runtime fingerprint 9f71a16e87ff72f2e41abb915cbdf82076108606481f5bb31b7e2f7b04bdc015 through Login with ChatGPT (chatgpt/gpt-6-luna actor and judge): options_single_leg_chain_and_quote, options_credit_spread_close_signed_quantities, attention_event_driven_review and options_team_call_vertical_entry_exit_reentry passed 4 of 4 on 2026-11-12 with $0 API spend. Reviewed the next-version Polygon trading-date cache repair: aware US-equity observations now establish their New York session date, while confirmed-empty dates and other asset conventions remain compatible. These retained in-memory Pandas option/attention actors never construct PolygonDataBacktesting or call polygon_helper, so their original prices, messages, tools, decisions, fills, source dates and verdicts remain valid. Nine new neutral regressions and14 existing affected cache checks passed; zero new model attempts. The example source under separate active validation is parked outside this release candidate. Reporting-only addition: published QuantStats Lumi 1.1.6 changes small compounded-return headings; the dependency floor, existing report documentation and saved report artifacts do not change agent prompts, shared skills, tools, strategy decisions, order execution or fixture inputs. Three focused native integration checks passed against the published package. Preserve earlier actor/judge evidence and SDK identities; zero new model runs are warranted. MetaMask execution/recovery, registry and complete-window cash-reporting fixes use its live adapter. Retained fixtures instantiate the Pandas BacktestingBroker, which has no get_cash_event_sync method, so the changed receipt-capable cash-reporting branch cannot execute; its legacy get_cash_events call is unchanged. No agent prompt, skill, tool schema or fixture is changed by the MetaMask integration. Eight focused local regression instances passed on the reviewed source, and two affected callback instances passed after integrating dev. Preserve their original sources and every original actor/judge result; zero new model runs are warranted. Release-captain review of the final 4.6.55 candidate (2026-11-13): the runtime files changed since the MetaMask review are the Alpaca OAuth shared-bar-cache key (alpaca_history, alpaca_backtesting), the IBKR futures roll prefetch window (interactive_brokers_rest_backtesting), additive indicator drawings (indicators base, runner, drawings, __init__) and bounded Parquet decoding when merging agent trace parts after a run (agents manager _AgentDetailSpool). The two retained cases use in-memory Pandas fixtures: they never construct Alpaca or IBKR sources, never draw indicators, and the trace merge runs only when saving diagnostic records, after every model call, message, tool result and order is complete; it rewrites the same rows with the same schema. Their prompts, tools, prices, decisions, fills and verdicts are unchanged. Focused code tests cover each change; zero new model runs are warranted. Preserve all original native sources, dates, calls and verdicts. Captain addendum: the IBKR crypto and futures quote derivation now fills only bars present in the trade series when quote bars carry extra timestamps (previously a KeyError). The retained cases never construct IBKR sources, so their inputs and verdicts are unchanged; two neutral regressions cover the fix. Zero new model runs. 4.6.56 author review for candidate 14758f44338a58f052327917c99983f7f6c8a04b76976c7fbf371178010c56bc: the delta is intraday futures lookback sizing in the IBKR backtesting sources (session-calendar bar counting), IBKR hour bar-size mapping and permanent bar-size rejection, CME business-day crude oil last trade dates with same-month registry disambiguation, and an optional compute_history protocol in Indicators.get used only when an executor's prepared object defines it. The retained cases run in-memory Pandas fixtures: they never construct IBKR sources, never request crude or intraday futures history, and no built-in indicator defines compute_history, so the default executor path is byte-for-byte the previous per-bar path. Prompts, skills, tool schemas, prices, decisions, fills and verdicts are unchanged. Focused code tests cover each change (session gaps 6, hour bar size 11, crude calendar 5, whole-history 7, plus existing affected suites). Preserve original sources, dates, calls, SDKs and verdicts; zero new model runs. Updated review for 4.6.59 candidate c19b9d75f793d825ac72229ecc294d6c369653a306bdf67009a1d60535075eb7: get_orders accepts documented status strings (enum inputs behave as before), IBKR futures history stops at a dated contract's last trading day and an order left working after its contract expires is canceled, a failed older IBKR history page is retried a bounded number of times, and an HTTP 403 on Alpaca option bars raises one clear data-plan error. Retained Pandas option/attention fixtures never call get_orders with strings, trade no dated futures, and never construct IBKR or Alpaca sources, so their prices, orders, fills and verdicts are unchanged; zero new model runs. Updated review for 4.6.60 candidate 7c88574a77db176cffce4ef03d49536bccb9f4d185edd07eabef7f0bb1e86e09: option backtest fills are priced from the fill bar (a real quote on that bar, else a real trade in that bar, else a labeled Black-Scholes estimate used as computed, with an optional penalty setting that defaults to 0), multi-leg packages fill every leg on one bar or none, offsetting in-the-money legs settle in cash at expiry, and the data downloader queue client sends an optional request_class label only when DATADOWNLOADER_REQUEST_CLASS is set. This touches the BacktestingBroker package path the retained Pandas option/attention fixtures use, so it was checked directly instead of assumed: those fixtures carry a two-sided quote and volume on every minute bar for every listed contract, so every leg is priced from the fill bar's own quote both before and after. A deterministic probe ran the same orders_submit_multileg packages (two-long/one-short call ratio on flat_options_account, one-by-one call spread on flat_options_multi_session, fastest and patient styles) and a single-leg option buy (limit and market) on the previous dev source and on this candidate: tool results, order statuses, leg fill prices and signed package prices were identical after removing random identifiers (ratio 3.00 debit, spread 0.80 debit, single call 1.70). No fill is estimated, no leg waits for another, and nothing is held to expiry in these fixtures. tests/test_agent_eval_harness.py and tests/test_agent_package_greeks.py passed 408 of 408 on the candidate. No agent prompt, skill, tool schema or fixture changed, and the fixtures never call the data downloader. Prices, orders, fills and verdicts are unchanged; zero new model runs. Updated review for 4.6.61 candidate 8f1c881b1ada85978b1168df1a91155ad7657622dd1d7f557b288938769d051f: when an option order has no real quote and no real trade on its fill bar, the labeled estimate now takes its volatility from a smile fitted across the expiration's recent trades if minute trade bars of at least five other contracts of that expiration are already in memory (new pure-numpy module lumibot.tools.option_price_estimate, called only from BacktestingBroker._estimate_option_price_now); otherwise the previous own-trade estimate runs unchanged. The retained Pandas option/attention fixtures carry a two-sided quote on every minute bar for every listed contract, so every fill is priced from the fill bar's own quote and the estimate path is never entered (the 4.6.60 probe found no estimated fill). No agent prompt, skill, tool schema or fixture changed. Focused code tests cover the change (module 14, broker wiring 7, existing fill-bar suites). Prices, orders, fills and verdicts are unchanged; zero new model runs.
